name: open-parcels-extension
description: Companion browser extension for the open-parcels web UI: catches phone-app sign-in redirects.

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm test && npm run build && npm run lint:firefox
scripts.package: npm run check && web-ext build -s dist/firefox -a release -n open-parcels-firefox-$npm_package_version.zip --overwrite-dest && web-ext build -s dist/chromium -a release -n open-parcels-chromium-$npm_package_version.zip --overwrite-dest && git archive --format=zip -o release/open-parcels-extension-source-$npm_package_version.zip HEAD
